build_tiny_vit_5m_model: build a TinyViT 5M parameter model with 224x224 input resolution using tiny_vit_5m_224
build_tiny_vit_21m_model: build a TinyViT 21M parameter model with 224x224 input resolution using tiny_vit_21m_224
